comment: Dr. LeViness is an incredible professor. His lectures are sometimes dry (especially toward the end of the semester) but he is well qualified as the director of CAPS to teach Psychology. Tons of extra credit opportunities. Tests are not bad. Assignments are unique and fun. You actually learn about yourself. I suggest this class if going clinical!
Dr. Levines is AMAZING he is so sweet and knows a lot about the subject. If you participate, do the homework, and study the notes you will be fine! I loved him and this class.

He is the head of CAPS and therefore cares a lot about the subject he teaches and his students. However, he is extremely boring! He looks and the ground and only uses powerpoint. He does give extra credit and you will get a good grade. But be prepared to sit on your laptop and be bored all class.
He's great. Kind of shy but so sweet and helpful. Very nice and fun class.

Dr.LeViness is a really nice guy and his class has been a lot of fun. The topics are really interesting and he only assigns a minimum amount of work and consistant readings as stated in his clear syllabus. The class is not overly challenging and you'll get a lot out of it. I'd recommend it for anyone regardless of their major!
Very good teacher - class can be somewhat repetitive, but if you do your work and study really hard for midterm and final, you will get an A

I just had him for postive psychology and it was a good class.  Fairly easy amounts of work.  The midterm and final were pretty specific but those were the only tests.  He's such a nice guy and really likes getting to know his students.

I had him for Controveries in Clinical Psychology. The class had a decent amount of work each week and papers, but it was a lot of fun. He is somewhat boring, but not a hard grader. Class discussions were interesting and beneficial.

Dr. LeViness is also the director of CAPS, and a really nice guy.  He is somewhat softspoken, but makes the class environment comfortable enough for even the quieter students like myself to speak out.  Very intelligent.  No surprises as far as classwork goes, everything is the same each week.
